report:
Reviewed the full selector_whole_file claim, its ordinary implementation in review.rs and the complete associated ordinary whole_files_and_ranges_preserve_exact_line_endings_and_detect_selected_edits test. No TODO/N/A entries exist. Captured the fixture helper dependency.

The requirements are narrow: WholeFile selects all source-file text including any final newline and carries no additional selector data. Selector declares WholeFile as a unit variant under the tagged enum, with no range/identity payload. select resolves the fragment path and directly returns read_to_string without trimming, splitting lines, normalizing line endings or omitting a final delimiter. The path remains in InputFragment rather than being duplicated as selector data. Missing/unreadable/non-UTF8 files return errors rather than partial content.

capture_read saves the selected string via source_lines, which splits only on newline and preserves a terminal empty element, CR characters and blank lines. Rejoining saved contents with newline reconstructs the exact selected text. input_errors rereads an additional WholeFile with the same selector and compares the reconstructed saved string exactly; initial associated implementation WholeFiles are freshly rebuilt by inventory and compared in the initial prefix. This preserves the all-content scope through saving and checking rather than merely returning the right string once.

The test first establishes nearby LineRange behavior using mixed CRLF/LF, blank lines and an unterminated final line, then starts a fresh review and captures WholeFile twice. Each return must equal the complete expected mixed-line-ending file, both appended fragments must match, and joined saved contents must equal the entire source. After recording it adds only a final newline and asserts the gate becomes invalid. That final assertion would fail if WholeFile or its storage/freshness path discarded the trailing newline. The range portion separately demonstrates unselected changes may remain valid only for the range selector; it is not asserted as WholeFile behavior. Fixture helpers create actual files and production review/check records, while exact text comparisons are visible in the test body.

Source inspection of the unit variant accounts for the no-additional-data qualification; the direct full-file read and newline-sensitive test account for complete text capture. No source changes, suspected defect or additional edits were needed. This pass executed review start/read/record and source inspection only; no behavioral tests were rerun, and central suite results are not claimed as this reviewer's execution. Dependency capture is complete. No requested edits.
